residualExecutionPlan.reason: Large presentation ViewModels should be split only after deterministic tests make behavior changes observable without timing flakiness.
prerequisites: Worker client public contracts remain stable
steps: Split by feature facet, not generic helper layers.
Start with ShellConnectionStateViewModel because it coordinates worker state, Exchange state, command invalidation, startup alerts, and console visibility.

Then split MailboxListViewModel, MailboxPermissionsEditorViewModel, MailboxLicensesViewModel, ContactsViewModel, MobileDevicesViewModel, ComplianceViewModel, MigrationViewModel, PublicFoldersViewModel, MailSecurityViewModel, and MailboxSettingsEditorViewModel in that order unless tests show a lower-risk dependency order.
Move orchestration into focused presentation/application collaborators only when it removes concrete duplication or isolates a clear feature responsibility.
Keep business decisions out of XAML and code-behind.
Keep ViewModel public bindings stable unless all impacted XAML and tests are updated in the same change.

residualExecutionPlan.reason: PowerShell command module splits should happen after IPC/orchestration stabilization so command behavior can be verified independently from transport changes.
steps: Capture generated command text behavior with existing WorkerCommandTests before each file split.
Split ExoMailboxScriptFactory.cs first into focused mailbox script facets while preserving generated text byte-for-byte where practical.

Continue with ExoComplianceCommands.cs, ExoMailboxLicenseCommands.cs, ExoMobileDeviceCommands.cs, ExoMailboxReportingCommands.cs, ExoMigrationCommands.cs, ExoPermissionCommands.cs, ExoSupportCommands.cs, and ErrorClassifier.cs.

Preserve request sanitization, secret redaction, PowerShell quoting, Graph/Exchange command selection, and error classification behavior exactly unless a test-backed bug fix is explicitly part of the change.
Lower architecture line-count guardrails after each successful split.
